text: LUC MCCUTCHEON

title: Luc McCutcheon
text:
Research Engineer: VLA Post-Training
I’m a Research Engineer and PhD Candidate (completing Summer 2026) at the University of Surrey, specialising in reinforcement learning for distributed VLA post-training. I’m also Co-Founder and CTO of GeoSnap.
My work spans world models, Lyapunov stability functions, and sim-to-real transfer for humanoid robotics, with implementations in JAX and PyTorch. I’ve published at ICRA, NeurIPS, and IROS, and serve as a reviewer for top ML and robotics venues.
Previously, I’ve held research roles at Cambridge Consultants (humanoid RL) and Agile Loop (agentic AI pipelines), where I led teams and delivered production research to clients including Google Cloud and Lenovo.


Research Interests

Reinforcement learning for robotic control
Vision-Language-Action model fine-tuning
Neural Lyapunov functions for stability
Continual, multi-task and meta-learning
World models and model-based RL

title: Projects
text:
Cambridge Consultants — Research Scientist



Reinforcement learning pipelines for Unitree G1 humanoid locomotion. Developed stair-climbing policies in MuJoCo and Isaac Sim with sim-to-real transfer experiments on physical hardware. Additionally, I combined an MPC planner for zero-shot generalisation to safely navigate obstructed scenes.









Cambridge Consultants — Research Scientist



Fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action models (GR00T) for robotic manipulation tasks. Context-aware grasping and box picking with Unitree G1 humanoids. I’ve customised existing pipelines for supervised finetuning to Reinforcement Learning post-training. This was demonstrated at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026.
